top_signal.title: Doing $500k-1million a month in revenue, but I don’t have an hour to myself and I’m losing my mind.
top_signal.summary: I have a business doing $500k-$1million a month in revenue, im in 2000 retail doors, but I’m doing everything myself. Ads, email, SMS, product launches, product quality, packaging design, customer support, accounting, inventory, ops, numbers, and 100 other things.   I’m working 18–20 hours a day, no joke. I don’t have an hour to myself. And lately, it’s gotten to the point where I spend all day thinking about everything I need to do and barely get anything done.   I know I need to hire people, but I honestly don’t know where to start. I’d also feel weird being in charge of someone or having to boss them around and tell them what to do.   I also work from home, so if I got an employee they would be working from home aswell, and im not sure how to keep them accountable or on task? The experience I have from my family that work from home, is that they work for 1-2 hours out of their 8 hour paid time, and im really worried about that.   Anyone here been in this position? How did you figure out who to hire first, and how do you make sure they get stuff done and take stuff off your plate?   Edit: Thanks for all the responses and advice guys reading every single one and refreshing constantly to read all the new ones, extremely helpful.        submitted by     /u/knock_his_block_off       [link]       [comments]
